rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone has overstated something.

example.english: They exaggerate the story so much.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gong2 dou3 gam3 kwaa1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when pointing out that someone has made a particular fact or claim sound bigger than it is.

example.english: You exaggerate how good this phone is.
example.traditional: 你講大咗喎，呢部手機冇咁勁。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 daai6 zo2 wo3 ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 mou5 gam3 ging6

rows.note: Use this when the exaggeration is boastful, unreliable, or presented as empty talk.

example.english: He is just trying to exaggerate how much he earns in a day.
example.traditional: 佢話自己一日賺幾十萬，根本係吹水。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 jat1 jat6 zaan6 gei2 sap6 maan6 gan1 bun2 hai6 ceoi1 seoi2
